title: Crabstar | KEY.co
description_expanded: A short stroll from the sugar-white sands of Inlet Beach, this newly built coastal estate offers a seamless blend of high design and laid-back luxury. With six bedrooms and six-and-a-half-bathrooms spread across three spacious levels, the home was crafted to accommodate large families or groups in complete comfort. The main level centers around a chef’s kitchen outfitted with Thermador appliances, Calacatta Ultra quartz countertops, and warm natural cabinetry—opening into a beautifully designed living and dining area ideal for entertaining. Expansive porches and a private, heated pool create an inviting outdoor oasis, while an elevator, wet bar, and high-end finishes throughout elevate every moment of your stay. Three serene master suites, custom-built bunk rooms, and dual laundry spaces reflect the home's thoughtful, family-friendly layout. Designer touches from Home and Harmony add warmth and sophistication to each room, from rainfall showers and soaking tubs to elegant lighting and accent walls. Guests will also enjoy the convenience of a private garage, 6-seater golf cart, and 6 adult bikes for exploring the best of 30A. Whether sipping coffee on a quiet porch, riding to the beach, or relaxing poolside, this home delivers an effortless, luxurious escape in one of Florida’s most sought-after coastal communities.
